newsitem.title: UK: Cargo Link gets Barbados air operators certificate.
newsitem.headline: Cargo Link gets Barbados air operators certificate.

text.p: Recently-formed cargo carrier Cargo Link (Caribbean) has been awarded an air operators certificate by the Barbados civil aviation authority, said the airline's commercial director Peter Brooks.
He added that Cargo Link, a Barbados-registered company with the majority of its shares held by Barbadians, was currently in "a development stage from a regulatory point of view".

The carrier currently uses bellyhold cargo space on other airlines' passenger aircraft from Barbados to various Latin American destinations and is now involved in its own traffic rights negotiations, although Brooks declined to elaborate on these.
